# What check.py found when it landed, so that a red build means something new.
#
# Each line is a finding it still reports and nobody is fixing today. Delete a
# line when the thing is fixed; the check will catch it coming back, because
# coming back is a finding that is no longer listed here.
#
# The four dread-card guards and choice 312 are open questions rather than
# settled bugs -- the dread block is write-only bookkeeping whose reset policy
# nobody has decided, and mafia's own source says "Choice 312 is unknown", so
# its options are not documented anywhere to answer it from. The two descending
# loops are deliberate; both say so in a comment beside them.
#
# Regenerate with: python3 .github/check.py --baseline > .github/check-baseline.txt

UnderTheSeaGlobals.ash: for ... from 9 to 3 counts DOWN -- confirm that is meant
UnderTheSea_Choice.ash: choice 312: every answer is inside a branch -- confirm some path always answers
